# Why neuroim2?

The `neuroim2` package provides spatial-aware neuroimaging data
structures like `DenseNeuroVec` that carry voxel dimensions, spacing,
and affine information alongside the data. When you pass a
`DenseNeuroVec` to `write_lna()`, the spatial metadata is automatically
captured in the LNA file header so you do not lose coordinate
information during compression.

This vignette demonstrates a full round-trip: create a synthetic
`DenseNeuroVec`, compress it to an LNA file, read it back, and verify
that the data and metadata survive intact.

```{r}
library(neuroarchive)
library(neuroim2)
```

# Create Synthetic Data

We use `neuroim2::simulate_fmri()` to generate a small 6x6x4 volume
with 20 timepoints. This produces realistic-looking fMRI data with
temporal autocorrelation.

```{r create_data}
sp <- neuroim2::NeuroSpace(c(6L, 6L, 4L), spacing = c(2, 2, 2))
mask_arr <- array(TRUE, dim = c(6L, 6L, 4L))
mask_vol <- neuroim2::NeuroVol(as.integer(mask_arr), sp)
sim <- neuroim2::simulate_fmri(mask_vol, n_time = 20L, seed = 42L)
vec <- methods::as(sim, "DenseNeuroVec")

cat(sprintf("Dimensions: %s\n", paste(dim(vec), collapse = " x ")))
cat(sprintf("Spacing: %s mm\n", paste(spacing(sp), collapse = " x ")))
cat(sprintf("Data range: [%.2f, %.2f]\n",
            min(as.array(vec)), max(as.array(vec))))
```

# Write to LNA

`write_lna()` accepts a `DenseNeuroVec` directly. The spatial header
(dimensions, spacing, origin) is stored automatically in the HDF5 file.

```{r write_lna}
tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".lna.h5")

result <- write_lna(vec, tmp, transforms = "quant",
                    transform_params = list(quant = list(bits = 8)))
print(result)
```

# Read Back

`read_lna()` returns a `DataHandle` with the reconstructed data in
`$stash$input`.

```{r read_back}
handle <- read_lna(tmp)
recon <- handle$stash$input

cat(sprintf("Reconstructed shape: %s\n",
            paste(dim(recon), collapse = " x ")))
```

# Verify Reconstruction Quality

```{r verify_quality}
orig <- as.vector(as.array(vec))
rec  <- as.vector(recon)

cor_val <- cor(orig, rec)
max_err <- max(abs(orig - rec))
nmse <- mean((orig - rec)^2) / var(orig)

cat(sprintf("Correlation: %.4f\n", cor_val))
cat(sprintf("Max error:   %.4f\n", max_err))
cat(sprintf("NMSE:        %.6f\n", nmse))
```

With 8-bit quantization, the correlation should be very close to 1.

```{r slice_comparison, echo = FALSE, fig.width = 5, fig.height = 4, fig.cap = "Original vs reconstructed values (subsampled)."}
set.seed(1)
idx <- sample(length(orig), min(2000, length(orig)))
plot(orig[idx], rec[idx],
     pch = ".", cex = 2, col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.3),
     xlab = "Original", ylab = "Reconstructed",
     main = "Original vs Reconstructed")
abline(0, 1, col = "red", lwd = 1.5)
```

# Header Preservation

The LNA file stores the spatial metadata from the `DenseNeuroVec`
in the `/header` HDF5 group. You can inspect it directly:

```{r header_check}
h5 <- hdf5r::H5File$new(tmp, mode = "r")

if (h5$exists("header")) {
  header_group <- h5[["header"]]
  cat("Header contents:\n")
  cat(sprintf("  Items: %s\n",
              paste(names(header_group), collapse = ", ")))

  # Show spatial dimensions if stored
  if (header_group$exists("dim")) {
    cat(sprintf("  Dimensions: %s\n",
                paste(header_group[["dim"]]$read(), collapse = " x ")))
  }
}

h5$close()
```

# Different Pipelines

You can use any transform pipeline with `DenseNeuroVec` data, just as
you would with a plain array.

## PCA Basis + Embedding + Quantization

```{r pipeline_basis}
tmp2 <- tempfile(fileext = ".h5")

write_lna(vec, tmp2,
          transforms = c("basis", "embed", "quant"),
          transform_params = list(
            basis = list(k = 10),
            quant = list(bits = 8)
          ))

handle2 <- read_lna(tmp2)
recon2 <- handle2$stash$input

cat(sprintf("Basis+Embed+Quant correlation: %.4f\n",
            cor(as.vector(as.array(vec)), as.vector(recon2))))
cat(sprintf("File size: %.1f KB\n", file.info(tmp2)$size / 1024))
```

## Lossless Delta Encoding

```{r pipeline_delta}
tmp3 <- tempfile(fileext = ".h5")

write_lna(vec, tmp3, transforms = "delta")

handle3 <- read_lna(tmp3)
recon3 <- handle3$stash$input

max_err3 <- max(abs(as.vector(as.array(vec)) - as.vector(recon3)))
cat(sprintf("Delta (lossless) max error: %e\n", max_err3))
```

```{r cleanup, include = FALSE}
unlink(c(tmp, tmp2, tmp3))
```
